meanings assigned to them in the Credit Agreement. SECTION 2. Amendments to Agreement . (a) The definition of the term “Maximum Facility Amount” appearing in Section 1.01 of the Credit Agreement
is hereby amended and restated in its entirety as follows: “ Maximum Facility Amount ” means, on any date of calculation,
(A) prior to the Pricing Date, the lesser of (x) $562,500,000 (as such amount may be increased pursuant to Section 2.13 ) and (y) the then aggregate outstanding principal amount of all the Subordinated Notes with respect
to which funds have been received in the Custodial Account as notified to the Administrative Agent by the Collateral Agent as of such date of calculation multiplied by three (3) and (B) on or after the Pricing Date, the greater of
(1) the applicable amount specified in clause (A) above and (2) if the aggregate outstanding principal amount of all Subordinated Notes with respect to which funds have been received in the Custodial Account as notified to the
Administrative Agent by the Collateral Agent is at least $15,000,000, the least of (x) $675,000,000 (as such amount may be increased pursuant to Section 2.13 ), (y) the then aggregate outstanding principal amount of all
Subordinated Notes with respect to which funds have been received in the Custodial Account as notified to the Administrative Agent by the Collateral Agent as of such date of calculation multiplied by nine (9) and (z) an amount equal to

# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

**MERLIN FUNDING LLC - FIFTH AMENDMENT TO CREDIT AGREEMENT**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** August 15, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Merlin Funding LLC, with Apollo Debt Solutions BDC as its sole member

**Transaction Description:** Fifth Amendment to an existing Credit Agreement originally dated October 6, 2023. This is a warehouse credit facility with Morgan Stanley Bank, N.A. as lender, Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. as administrative agent, and Deutsche Bank National Trust Company as collateral agent. Apollo Debt Solutions BDC serves as both the warehouse collateral manager and subordinated lender.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment modifies facility size limits and portfolio parameters for what appears to be a CLO (Collateralized Loan Obligation) warehouse facility, as evidenced by references to collateral requirements for CLO closing and pricing dates.

**Company Background:** Merlin Funding LLC operates as a special purpose vehicle managed by Apollo Debt Solutions BDC, structured to facilitate CLO transactions through a warehouse lending arrangement with Morgan Stanley entities.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Strong sponsorship** - Apollo Debt Solutions BDC serves multiple roles (sole member, collateral manager, subordinated lender)
• **Established banking relationship** - Fifth amendment indicates ongoing, mature relationship with Morgan Stanley
• **Conservative leverage structure** - Maximum facility tied to subordinated note multiples (3x pre-pricing, up to 9x post-pricing)
• **Experienced collateral agent** - Deutsche Bank National Trust Company provides third-party oversight
• **Built-in deleveraging mechanism** - Facility amount reduces to outstanding advances upon default or commitment termination

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Concentration risk** - Heavy reliance on single sponsor (Apollo) across multiple roles
• **Market timing risk** - Facility expansion dependent on successful CLO pricing and market conditions
• **Complexity risk** - Multiple calculation methodologies for facility size may create operational challenges
• **CLO market exposure** - Success tied to broader CLO market performance and investor demand

---

| **Term** | **Details** |
|----------|-------------|
| **Deal Size** | Maximum Facility: $562.5MM (pre-pricing) / up to $675MM (post-pricing) |
| **Deal Price** | N/A |

| **Payment Frequency** | N/A |
| **Subordinated Lender Commitment** | $187,500,000 |
| **Maximum Traded Portfolio** | $750,000,000 (pre-pricing) |
| **Key Covenant - Minimum Subordinated Notes** | $15,000,000 (for post-pricing facility expansion) |
| **Leverage Multiple** | 3x subordinated notes (pre-pricing) / up to 9x (post-pricing) |
| **Governing Law** | New York State Law |
